// diagnostic

E2119

`{argument}` isn't a deep-check scope.

What

`{argument}` isn't a deep-check scope.

Why

A deep-check scope is a package name, then module, type and function names, joined by `.`; each name is letters, digits, `_` and `-`.

Fix

Write `--deep-checks` for every deep check, or name a scope, such as `--deep-checks=tree.run`.

Worked example
